context: Ren and Sho-young watch a kids' nature documentary together.
purpose: Adult mentor and child experiencing science wonder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、すごい動物!
lines.style: Bright burst of excitement, childlike wonder breaking through. Quick tempo, genuine delight—not performing for attention but genuinely amazed. Voice opens wide on the animals part.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Nature really is mysterious, isn't it…
lines.style: Soft, reflective, speaking as much to himself as to Sho. Warm awe underneath. Slight pause before the question mark—actually wondering. Gentle exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: We have to take care of it though. The environment, I mean.
lines.style: Small voice finding firmness. Not bossy—thoughtful. A child working through something serious. Slight hesitation before clarifying, then conviction settles in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、君もできること、たくさん。
lines.en: Yeah—there's tons you can do, actually.
lines.style: Warm reassurance, but grounded. Not patronizing—speaking to Sho's seriousness with equal weight. Encouraging without being over-bright. Steady, believing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm going to protect it. For sure.
lines.style: Small voice with big certainty. Promise-like. No doubt wavering through it. Opens clear, lands solid. The kind of simple dedication only a six-year-old can deliver without irony.
